title: Hatsune Miku — Wonder☆Christmas〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: On This Holy Night, I Sing

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
It's almost Christmas♪
What's our show gonna be like?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, how about one with lots of Santas!
Having lots of presents would be so much fun☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And what else... Oh? It's the plushies.

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line:
Did you hear?
KAITO's planning a Christmas show!

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line:
What, really?
What's it going to be like?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Yay! It seems everyone's looking forward to Christmas!)

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: Apparently this thing called snow is supposed to fall during Christmas too.

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line:
It's white, fluffy and falls from the sky!
It even disappears when you touch it!

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: That's so strange, but it must be pretty! I'd like to see it!

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: And, and, there's something called a sleigh that you can ride on and fly around the sky!

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Wow! Will that be in the show too?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(Snow and a flying sleigh...
Hehehe. These are some good ideas!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Hmm, I wonder if the plushies know about Santa too? And the reindeer? He's the one that rides the sleigh while delivering everyone's presents after all...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO's Voice
rows.Line: Miku! Come over and let's start talking about our next show!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sure♪ I'll be right there!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: First, does anyone already have any ideas for what they'd like to have in our Christmas show?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes! Me! Me! Me!
I want to have snow falling on the stage!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Snow on the stage...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
And reindeer too!
With a sleigh that flies around the sky♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wow, reindeer and a flying sleigh?!
That all of that sounds really fun!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, those are some great ideas. And of course, it wouldn't be Christmas without Santa.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Now let's think about how we can make it all happen.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah! We can do it! I know it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha, you're burning with motivation!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (The plushies will love it!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: One more thing! Let's invite the Wonderlands troupe♪ They might be able to give us some exciting ideas for our show too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's do it together with them!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay! I'll go over to Phoenix Wonderland to see Emu and the others!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sob... I'm back...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Are you okay, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What's wrong? Were you able to talk to them?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
No, I did but...
They're all busy preparing for their own show.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Nene looked so sad too and said she wasn't interested in joining our show.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So they won't perform with us?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, I'm not giving up just yet...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't know what's eating away at Nene, but...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Tsukasa seemed determined to help her!
And I'm sure he will!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I see.
In that case we can invite them again later.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (We'd still need someone to help with our show, though... But I know who else I might be able to recruit as actors.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Worst case scenario, we can at least invite them to watch our play.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! And the plushies have to see the show too! They'll get so excited about the snow and the flying sleigh!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yup! Um, wait a minute...
How did you know about the plushies?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We were talking about the show while you went over to Phoenix Wonderland.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It was easy to guess why you suggested snow and the sleigh since the plushies were talking about them too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehehe, was it that obvious?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We're going to have our hands full preparing this show. Let's all do our best!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay! Let's make it the best Christmas show ever and bring Christmas cheer to everyone♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah!
